item.title: Shrinkwrap 0.25.0
item.description: AI upscaling: images too small for their target are now enlarged by an on-device model instead of coming out short — on by default, with a Fast/Best engine picker in Settings and @upscale / @upscale-fast / @upscale-full / @noupscale for per-folder control. Fixes @face silently producing a plain centre crop on headshots where the subject already fills the frame.
